name: Beryl Grace
description: Beryl Grace was an actress with drinking problems. She would constantly perform stunts to make sure that she was always in the tabloids, though she'll also get criticized for her unstable and self-serving attitudes within the said tabloids, with critics wishing she went to a mental asylum.  She is mother of Thalia and Jason Grace through Zeus/Jupiter.

name: Emily Zhang
description: Emily Zhang was a Greek legacy of Poseidon, the descendant of Periclymenus, an Argonaut, and a lover of Mars. She was also the daughter of Grandma Zhang and the mother of Frank Zhang, one of the seven in the prophecy. Emily Zhang was a Canadian soldier who died during the war in Afghanistan, while saving a few comrades' lives.

name: Esperanza Valdez
description: Esperanza Valdez was a human Hispanic American mechanic and the mother of Greek demigod Leo Valdez, whom she had with Hephaestus. Esperanza was also the sister of Rosa Valdez. Three years after the departure of Hera, Esperanza Valdez was killed in a fire at the machine shop caused by Gaea, when the Mother Earth faced eight-year-old Leo Valdez. Her death resulted in Leo running away, and his eventual enrollment in Wilderness School after he was rejected by his aunt Rosa Valdez, who blamed him for the death of her sister. Leo believed he had caused her death for a long time.

name: Estelle Blofis
description: Estelle Blofis is Percy Jackson's younger mortal half-sister.

name: Frederick Chase
description: Dr. Frederick Chase is the American and Military History professor at West Point. He is the mortal father of Greek demigod Annabeth Chase and her half-brothers, Bobby Chase and Matthew Chase, brother of Randolph and Natalie Chase, and husband of Mrs. Chase.

name: Gabe Ugliano
description: Gabriel 'Gabe' Ugliano was Percy Jackson's neglectful, abusive stepfather in The Lightning Thief. He was petrified by Medusa's Head and sold as a statue titled 'The Poker Player' to an unknown art museum somewhere in Soho.

name: Julian Ramírez-Arellano
description: Julian Ramírez-Arellano was the lover of Bellona and father of Hylla and Reyna Ramírez-Arellano. Up until the birth of his eldest daughter, Julian was a former soldier who served in Iraq. He suffered from post traumatic stress disorder and eventually madness took over and he was killed by his younger daughter.

name: Lester Papadopoulos
description: Lester Papadopoulos is the mortal teenage incarnation of the god Apollo. He has to deal with such ordinary human problems as zits, flabby muscles, and feeling pain when he falls into a Dumpster. When he isn’t writing lame haiku or complaining bitterly to his father, Zeus, he is looking for Oracles to restore in an attempt to earn his way back to Mount Olympus.

name: Maria Di Angelo
description: Maria di Angelo was an Italian woman, and the mother of Greek demigods Bianca and Nico di Angelo. During the time Maria and Hades were together, the Great Prophecy had been spoken and World War II was beginning. Hades wanted to hide Maria and their children in the Underworld so that Zeus wouldn't be able to find out about them. However, Maria refused to raise her children there as they would be away from her family. While she was in a hotel, Zeus destroyed it, killing Maria. A devastated Hades then told Alecto to bring Nico and Bianca to the River Lethe to have their memories wiped, then to the Lotus Hotel and Casino, where time stands still. Maria's tragic death caused Hades a lot of devastation and bitterness towards his family, which in turn led him to the curse the Oracle, who had warned Hades to hide his children sooner.

name: Marie Levesque
description: Marie Levesque is a mortal fortune teller and spirit medium from New Orleans who became the lover of the Roman god Pluto and the mother of the demigod Hazel Levesque. Driven by a lifelong desire for wealth, she selfishly wished for all the riches of the earth from Pluto, which accidentally cursed her daughter with precious metals that brought doom to anyone who touched them. Later influenced and possessed by the earth goddess Gaea, Marie moved with Hazel to Alaska, where she tragically died alongside her daughter from oil inhalation while trying to help revive the giant Alcyoneus.

name: May Castellan
description: May Castellan is Luke Castellan's mother. She was born with the gift of prophecy and attempted to possess the Oracle's body, but failed due to Hades' curse upon it. When May tried to take over the Oracle, she saw completely insane glimpses of her son Luke's future, which drove her to madness.

name: Naomi Solace
description: Naomi Solace is a human alt-country singer and the mother of Greek demigod Will Solace. She would often tour and take Will with her. On one stop in New York City, Naomi insisted she and her son travel only by subway for their time in the city. During her career, Naomi once opened for Billy Joel and has met Beyonce.

name: Paul Blofis
description: Paul Blofis is Percy Jackson's supportive stepfather, an English teacher, and the husband of Sally Jackson

name: Phillip McCaffrey
description: Phillip McCaffrey was a mortal botanist, a descendant of Plemnaeus, and the loving father of the demigod Meg McCaffrey. He had a brief romantic relationship with Demeter, the Greek goddess of the harvest. He raised Meg in a complex of green sanctuaries called Aeithales in Palm Springs, California, where he successfully discovered seven seeds for primordial dryads. Tragically, his work drew the attention of the Roman Triumvirate. He was bankrupted by Caligula, who burned down his greenhouses, and was later murdered in New York City on the orders of Nero, who used the trauma of his death to psychologically manipulate and control Meg.

name: Rachel Elizabeth Dare
description: Rachel Elizabeth Dare is the child of mortal parents Mr. Dare and Mrs. Dare. She currently hosts the spirit of the Oracle of Delphi.

name: Sally Jackson
description: Sally Jackson-Blofis is the mortal mother of Greek demigod Percy Jackson and his mortal maternal half-sister Estelle Blofis. She is the widow of Gabe Ugliano and is currently married to Paul Blofis.

name: Sergei Asimov
description: Sergei Asimov is a Russian ballet dancer and father of Lavinia Asimov. Not much is known about Sergei’s early life except that he made a name for himself as a professional ballet dancer and had a daughter with Terpsichore, the Muse of dance and choral songs. When his daughter informed him she wanted to study tap dancing rather then ballet, he became disappointed.

name: Tristan McLean
description: Tristan McLean is a famous film star of Cherokee descent. He is one of Aphrodite's mortal lovers, and the father of Greek demigod Piper McLean.
